description: Install and set up StateRoot, the continuity layer for AI coding agents. Switch harnesses. Keep the agent: personality, plans, tools and skills, memories, learnings, and project context carry across Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Kimi Code, OpenClaw, and other supported harnesses. Use this bootstrap skill when the user asks to install or set up StateRoot, when `stateroot` is missing from PATH, or when setup has not run. After setup, follow the built-in StateRoot skill for resume, checkpoint, handoff, memory, and daily workflow.

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent implement the requested change with minimal unrelated edits?
Did the agent verify behavior changes instead of relying on intuition?
